title: Logging inside S.tick floods check runs (hundreds of frames)
summary: A debug logger in a tick (bone positions) printed 330 lines during one CHECK run: layout checks render hundreds of frames. Log once, behind a URL flag, and never during checks.

versions.note: seed harvest of the shot-match scenes (L3)

usage.example: boneLog(S, figs)   // module.recon.rig-pose: ?bones=1 only, prints once

doc.when: Any debug output from a scene.

problem.symptom: A check or render run drowns in hundreds of log lines.
problem.cause: S.tick runs for every frame the checker renders.
problem.fix: Log once (a done flag) and only with a URL flag.
problem.detect: Log volume scales with the check's frame count.
